messages:
leo.sales: Quick help - Nimbus signed the LOI and wants a hosted API key for a 5-day eval starting tomorrow. Requirements: scoped to embeddings+generate, IPs 34.210.1.0/24 and 3.15.2.8/32, TTL 5 days, and an auditable revocation path for their security team. Can eng/security issue and confirm delivery method?

anya.eng: We can issue a scoped short-lived key. For multi-IP allowlist we accept CIDR list. TTL 5 days is fine (max 30d for POCs). We can either create via Console or Keys API.

mira.security: Please include where audit events land (S3 export vs Console) and whether rotation can be automated mid-run. Also need assurance that once revoked the token is unusable immediately.

anya.eng: Audit events are written to the Console activity stream and to tenant audit export (S3 bucket export if configured). Hosted default retention is 90 days; we can enable longer retention for enterprise customers by request. Revocation is immediate - token checks a revoke flag at auth time.

anya.eng: Sample create-key payload (replace values):

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/keys \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "name":"nimbus-eval-2026-03", 
    "scopes":["inference:generate","embeddings:create"],
    "allowed_ips":["34.210.1.0/24","3.15.2.8/32"],
    "expires_at":"2026-03-27T09:00:00Z",
    "notes":"POC - Nimbus, 5d, non-prod"
  }'
```

anya.eng: For rotation you can either call `POST /v1/keys/{key_id}/rotate` or create a rotation job. To revoke immedately use `PATCH /v1/keys/{key_id}` with `{"revoked":true}` or `DELETE` which also revokes.

leo.sales: Can you create it and DM me the masked token + key_id so I can give to the customer? Also set up one auto-rotate at day 2 and email the new token to the SLA contact.

infra-bot: Key create request received. Processing...

anya.eng: Created key. Key ID: kid_a9c1d4. Masked token to send: sk-****c2d4. Expires: 2026-03-27T09:00:00Z. Allowed IPs: [34.210.1.0/24, 3.15.2.8/32]. Audit event: evt_20260322_1145 logged.

mira.security: Please schedule the automatic rotate at day 2 and ensure the rotation flow records old/new key IDs in the same audit trace. Need S3 audit path to hand to Nimbus security.

anya.eng: Rotation job scheduled for 2026-03-25T09:00:00Z (one run). Rotation flow will create new key, email token to the specified contact, then revoke the prior key; all steps linked in audit rot_20260325_01 and attached to evt_20260322_1145.

anya.eng: Audit export location (if tenant export enabled): s3://redwood-audit-exports/nimbus-tenant/2026-03/. Console also shows events under Settings -> Audit.

mira.security: Good. Final note for questionnaire: hosted uses Redwood KMS by default for key material; enterprise can enable BYOK via KMS integration for longer-term or regulated deployments. Include revocation methods (Console/API/DELETE/PATCH) and retention (90d default).

leo.sales: Thanks everyone. I'll pass sk-****c2d4 + allowed IPs to Nimbus security and attach the audit export path. Will also tell them rotation occurs automatically on day 2. :thumbsup:
